summary: Iteration 22 (Lightbox overhaul + pagination + auto ALT). Backend ALT generator + all endpoints PASS (9/9 pytest). WorksPage lightbox PASS. CRITICAL BUG on GalleryPage: the new shared Lightbox component is imported but never rendered — an old inline lightbox with the 'SHARE AS PIN ↗' pill and the wrong testids is still active, and it displays no image because it reads lightbox.image while state now holds {photos, index}.

ui_bugs.issue: Old inline lightbox is still rendered instead of the new shared <Lightbox testIdPrefix='gallery'> component. Consequences: (a) 'SHARE AS PIN ↗' gold pill is still visible in the DOM — must be removed per spec; (b) missing testids gallery-lightbox-prev / gallery-lightbox-next / gallery-lightbox-counter / gallery-lightbox-img / gallery-lightbox-share / gallery-lightbox-close; existing testids are the legacy 'lightbox-close' / 'lightbox-share' (no 'gallery-' prefix); (c) no prev/next arrows, no ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Escape keyboard support, no swipe navigation; (d) image never renders because openLightbox now sets state={photos,index} but the inline JSX reads lightbox.image / lightbox.title which are undefined → the modal opens as a dark backdrop with only the SHARE AS PIN pill visible (see screenshot).

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/GalleryPage.jsx, DELETE the entire inline lightbox block (roughly lines 233-272 — from `{/* Lightbox */}` through the closing `` before ``), and REPLACE it with a render of the shared component: ``. The state helpers openLightbox/closeLightbox/setLightboxIndex are already defined correctly at lines 42-44 and the import already exists at line 10.
After fix, re-run the frontend test to confirm testids gallery-lightbox-prev/next/counter/img/share/close all render and the SHARE AS PIN pill is gone from /gallery.

(Optional) In /app/frontend/src/components/Lightbox.jsx the Escape handler occasionally leaves the modal in the DOM for ~500ms while AnimatePresence runs its exit — not a bug, just noting the exit animation takes longer than a typical Playwright wait; not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: GalleryPage.jsx keeps a duplicate inline lightbox implementation despite importing the new shared Lightbox component — classic half-migration. Remove the legacy JSX to avoid drift.

Lightbox.jsx keyboard handler binds to window and correctly detaches on close — good; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Escape all verified live on WorksPage.
